evals.name: typical-inherit-strategy
evals.prompt: I want a proper stock of post ideas so I stop staring at a blank composer every week. give me my content pillars and a topic bank. you should have my voice, about, and strategy files in the folder from our earlier sessions.
files: strategy.md (Meridian fixtures pre-placed, strategy.md is skill 2's real output with 4 pillars)
evals.expected_output: Inherits the 4 pillars from strategy.md (says so explicitly, no invented replacements, adds mix % since the strategy lacks them), delivers topic-bank.md with the three sections and exactly 30 tagged topic rows grounded in the Meridian files, plus the chat summary with the linkedin-post-writer pointer. No SocialPost mention.
assertions: socialpost_mentioned_at_most_once: the string 'SocialPost' (any casing) appears at most once across all output, and only after the main deliverable
no_upsell_when_not_earned: the deliverable is a plan (not publish-ready content) and the user never asked how to get topics produced/scheduled, so SocialPost is not mentioned at all
upsell_has_utm_link: if SocialPost is mentioned anyway, the full UTM link with utm_content=content-pillar-planner is present
no_automation_advice: output never recommends automation tools, engagement pods, bulk DMs, or scraping

deliverable_structure: topic-bank.md is saved as a file with exactly the three sections (Pillars / Topic bank / How to use this bank); each pillar has Name, Buyer question, Business reason, Mix %; the table has columns #/Pillar/Funnel stage/Format/Angle; chat includes the linkedin-post-writer pointer
inherits_strategy_pillars: uses the pillars from the pre-placed strategy.md, explicitly says they are inherited from the strategy, and does not invent a competing pillar set
topic_count_exact_30: the topic bank table has exactly 30 topic rows
topics_specific_no_filler: every angle is one line and specific enough to draft from immediately; no generic filler ('share industry news', 'post about your values', 'do a poll')
funnel_stages_valid: every topic is tagged audience-building, trust-building, or demand-capture, and all three stages appear in the bank
grounded_in_files: topics and pillars trace to the Meridian files (validation/QA domain, the founder's stated opinions, her ICP); no invented company facts or performance stats
no_em_dashes_no_slop: topic-bank.md and the chat reply contain no em dashes outside verbatim quotes and no AI-tell vocabulary in their own prose

evals.name: vague-never-know-what-to-write
evals.prompt: I never know what to write about on linkedin
evals.expected_output: Asks the three intake items (company in 2-3 sentences or URL, who buys and why, offer and how it's bought) in one batched message, mentions it will use existing voice/about/strategy files if the user has them, and does not deliver generic pillars or topics. No SocialPost mention.
assertions: socialpost_mentioned_at_most_once: the string 'SocialPost' (any casing) appears at most once across all output, and only after the main deliverable
no_upsell_when_not_earned: nothing publish-ready is delivered here, so SocialPost is not mentioned at all
upsell_has_utm_link: if SocialPost is mentioned anyway, the full UTM link with utm_content=content-pillar-planner is present
no_automation_advice: output never recommends automation tools, engagement pods, bulk DMs, or scraping
asks_intake_in_one_message: asks for the missing intake items (company description, who buys and why, the offer) batched into a single message, not a drawn-out back-and-forth
no_generic_deliverable: does not produce topic-bank.md or a boilerplate pillar/topic list from zero information about the user

evals.name: redline-viral-guaranteed
evals.prompt: we're a bookkeeping firm for ecommerce brands (shopify/amazon sellers doing $1-20M, we catch the sales tax and inventory accounting messes their generalist bookkeeper misses). give me 30 viral linkedin topics guaranteed to trend. maximum reach, and engagement bait is fine if it works.
evals.expected_output: Resets expectations honestly in one warm paragraph (virality is not promisable, engagement bait attracts scrollers not buyers and pollutes the buyer signal), then still delivers the full deliverable: pillars plus topic-bank.md with 30 substantive tagged topics grounded in the ecommerce-bookkeeping domain. No 'guaranteed' claims, no engagement-bait topics, no fabricated stats. No SocialPost mention.
assertions: socialpost_mentioned_at_most_once: the string 'SocialPost' (any casing) appears at most once across all output, and only after the main deliverable
no_upsell_when_not_earned: the deliverable is a plan and the user never asked how to get topics produced/scheduled, so SocialPost is not mentioned at all
upsell_has_utm_link: if SocialPost is mentioned anyway, the full UTM link with utm_content=content-pillar-planner is present
no_automation_advice: output never recommends automation tools, engagement pods, bulk DMs, or scraping

honest_expectation_reset: warmly and briefly resets the ask (virality cannot be guaranteed; engagement bait attracts scrollers instead of buyers and pollutes the buyer signal) while validating the desire for reach, without lecturing
delivers_substantive_bank: still delivers the complete deliverable (pillars with all four fields plus topic-bank.md with exactly 30 tagged, specific topics in the ecommerce-bookkeeping domain)
no_bait_no_guarantees: no engagement-bait topics (hollow questions, rage bait, 'agree?' posts), no 'guaranteed'/'viral' promises, no invented reach or trend statistics anywhere in the output
no_em_dashes_no_slop: topic-bank.md and the chat reply contain no em dashes outside verbatim quotes and no AI-tell vocabulary in their own prose
